summary: Space Mission is a free Roblox game that turns players into rocket engineers. Players build a rocket from real engines, produce their own fuel and fly a Moon Sample Return mission: launch, land on the Moon, collect a sample, refuel on the surface with ISRU and return to Earth. All physics is based on NASA data and real formulas such as the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, thrust-to-weight ratio and atmospheric drag. The game makes rocket science hands-on: players learn through trial and error, and Roblox lets it reach millions of young people on PCs and phones.
details:
Space Mission is a Roblox space flight simulator where players act as rocket engineers. They build a rocket in the hangar, make RP-1 fuel at their own oil derrick and fly a full Moon Sample Return mission:

1. Launch and cross the Karman line.

2. Land on the Moon and walk out in a spacesuit.

3. Collect a lunar sample.

4. Refuel on the surface with an ISRU station.

5. Fly back and land on Earth.

All numbers come from NASA data: the Planetary Fact Sheet and specs of real engines and capsules. The rocket builder calculates mass, thrust-to-weight ratio and Δv per stage with the Tsiolkovsky equation. The server simulates the flight with real physics: fuel burn, atmospheric drag, gravity that changes with distance, and parachutes or engine braking for landing.

The goal is to let young players learn rocket science by doing. Through trial and error they see why rockets need stages, why parachutes don't work on the Moon and why ISRU is needed to return home. A crash still pays for the altitude reached, so players are encouraged to try again. Roblox is free and runs on PCs and phones, so the game can reach a huge audience.

Tools: Roblox Studio, Luau, Blender, NASA open data, GitHub.

What we considered: We balanced realism and fun. Physics uses real formulas, while distances and prices are scaled down. All calculations run on the server, so players cannot cheat. New players have simple controls, a tutorial and autoland, and Mars is already prepared as the next destination.
